description: Opens a Zillow or Redfin listing in a visible tab, reads it exactly like DoorMeter's card (the listing's own HOA, tax, rent and value estimates), computes its numbers with the user's profile (and their saved edits if they saved it), then closes the tab unless keepOpen. Tabs open one at a time, a few seconds apart, without taking focus. Reading a listing counts it as opened (it no longer shows as new in search_results). Use it for homes search_results couldn't compute.

strategy.description: Strategy the numbers are computed in: buy-and-hold, house-hack, brrrr or live-in (living in it).

url.description: A Zillow or Redfin listing URL (one home's page, e.g. a "url" from search_results).

name: analyze_listing
